'''Sleep Center''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] chain with at least one establishment in the mid levels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was tolerant of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] guests and their upscale rooms cost upwards from 200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a day to rent.
